items: a) It ONLY enters a ({{condition|جملة إسمية}}) sentence.
b) The (جملة إسمية) sentence it enters will become a ({{ruling|مفرد}}) compound/phrase.
c) Together أَنَّ with it's إسم and خبر will ALWAYS fall into places of {{ruling|مفرد}}.
d) It also gives emphasis to the meaning from the perspective of the first person.
e) It will make the "مسند إليه" {{ruling|منصوب}} and it will make the "مسند" {{ruling|مرفوع}} if the مسند is a noun.

blocks.en: I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.

items: a) If it's خبر is a {{condition|جملة}}, whether فعلية or إسمية, there will not be any visible effect of the الحرف المشبهة بالفعل. The effect will only be {{ruling|assumed}}.

blocks.ar: مِنْ اِعْتِقَادِيْ أَنَّ اللهَ خَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
blocks.en: Of my belief is that Allah created everything.

items: a) If it's خبر is a {{condition|جملة}}, whether فعلية or إسمية, there will not be any visible effect of the الحرف المشبهة بالفعل. The effect will only be {{ruling|assumed}}.

blocks.en: I believe that Allah, His essence is one.

items: a) It is {{ruling|impermissible}} for it's خبر to precede it's إسم unless it's خبر is a {{condition|جار ومجرور}} or a {{condition|ظرف}}. In which case, it is permissible but not necessary.
b) This applies to all the الحروف المشبهة بالفعل.
c) Also, an appropriate auxiliary word will be employed.

blocks.en: It pleased me that in the house is Zayd.

items: a) It is {{ruling|impermissible}} for it's خبر to precede it's إسم unless it's خبر is a {{condition|جار ومجرور}} or a {{condition|ظرف}}. In which case, it is permissible but not necessary.
b) This applies to all the الحروف المشبهة بالفعل.
c) Also, an appropriate auxiliary word will be employed.

blocks.en: Indeed, with Allah are our deeds.

items: a) The "{{term|مَا الكَافَّة}}" can also attach to أَنَّ but will not affect the ability of أَنَّ converting the sentence to {{ruling|مفرد}}.
b) It will stop أَنَّ from {{ruling|governing}} the مبتدا and خبر. It will no longer make the "مبتدا" منصوب and the "خبر" مرفوع.
c) When this happens, أَنَّ can enter both, ({{ruling|جملة إسمية}}) & ({{ruling|جملة فعلية}}), sentences.

blocks.ar: أَ فَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَا كُمْ عَبَثًا
blocks.en: Did you then think that We created you in play?

items: a) The "مَا الكَافَّة" not only stops the governing of أَنَّ, but also stops أَنَّ from even having an {{ruling|إسم}} and a {{ruling|خبر}}.
b) The benefit of ({{term|حصر}}) exclusivity the "مَا الكَافَّة" provided when connected to إِنَّ is also found with أَنَّ prominently.
c) The "مَا الكَافَّة" will not affect the ability of أَنَّ converting the sentence to {{ruling|مفرد}}.

blocks.ar: إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ
blocks.en: It is only revealed to me that your god is one God.

items: a) The ability of أَنَّ in converting the sentence after it into مفرد adds أَنَّ to another group of words known as {{term|الموصولات الحرفية}} which share this same characteristic of converting sentences into مفرد.
b) This process is called: {{term|بِتَأْوِيل المصدر/المفرد}} (BTM) often manifesting as {{ruling|المركب الإضافي}}.
We will discuss this soon Insha'Allah!

blocks.en: It pleased me that Zayd is a Muslim.

items: a) It ONLY enters a ({{condition|جملة إسمية}}) sentence.
b) After it enters the (جملة إسمية) sentence, the construction will remain a ({{ruling|جملة}}).
c) It gives the meaning of it's إسم {{term|resembling}} it's خبر with emphasis.
d) It will make the "مسند إليه" {{ruling|منصوب}} and the "مسند" {{ruling|مرفوع}} if the مسند is a noun.

blocks.en: As if Zayd is a lion.

items: a) It will not visibly affect it's خبر if it is a {{condition|sentence}} just as إِنَّ and أَنَّ didn't visibly affect their خبر when it was a sentence.
b) The affect will be {{ruling|assumed}}.

blocks.en: As if Zayd is reading the Qur'an.

items: a) Rules relating to it's خبر preceding it's إسم are identical to those mentioned in إِنَّ and أَنَّ.
b) It is only when it's خبر is a {{condition|جار ومجرور}} or a {{condition|ظرف}} that it becomes {{ruling|permissible}} for it's خبر to precede it's إسم otherwise not.
c) This applies to all of the الحروف المشبهة بالفعل.
d) Also, an appropriate auxiliary word will be employed.

blocks.en: As if Zayd is with you.

items: e) The rules relating to "{{term|مَا الكَافَّة}}" are also identical to إِنَّ and أَنَّ in stopping the governing of كَأَنَّ.
a) However, there is {{ruling|no added benefit}} of the meaning of (حصر) exclusivity here.
b) When this happens, كَأَنَّ can enter both (جملة إسمية) & (جملة فعلية) sentences. Just like إِنَّ and أَنَّ, it will no longer be restricted to a جملة إسمية construction.

blocks.en: As if they are being driven to death.
